scientific_integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained; finite checker experiments are corroboration, not infinite proof. The circle specialization and center-exclusion probability are prior known facts. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Smooth strictly convex centrally symmetric planar curves and strictly positive symmetric C1 angular densities; asymptotic as sample size grows; no interior sampling, cornered curves, or higher dimensions; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Marked Wendel law and convex-order optimal sampling for random inscribed polygons
